steps.text: Electric field strength E = F/q, force per unit positive charge.
Field lines run from positive to negative charge; closer lines mean a stronger field.
Uniform field between parallel plates: E = V/d.
Point charges: Coulomb's law F = kq₁q₂/r² — an inverse-square law.
Electric potential is work per unit charge; it is zero at infinity.
A charge accelerates along the field direction if positive, opposite if negative.
